name: Xiamen ITG Group Corp.,Ltd
summary: Xiamen ITG Group Corp.,Ltd engages in the supply chain management, real estate, and financial service businesses. It operates through the Supply Chain Management Business, Health Technology Business, and Other Business segments. The company provides procurement, distribution, price management, logistics, financial, market and research analysis, digitalization, and industrial upgrading services.
